scripts.dev: npm run build -w sheetdelta-core && npm run dev -w @sheetdelta/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w sheetdelta-core && npm run build -w @sheetdelta/web
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run build
scripts.pack:core: npm run build -w sheetdelta-core && node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('artifacts', {recursive:true})" && npm pack -w sheetdelta-core --pack-destination artifacts
